question: Write a detailed explanation of section 8.1 “Measurement of Time”, using the textbook evidence and supporting details.
answer: Humans got interested in keeping track of time long ago. They started noticing that many events in nature repeat themselves after definite intervals of time. For example, the rising and setting of the Sun, the phases of the Moon and the changing seasons.
